description: This file defines trigonometric functions and related types for the FreeType project, including angle calculations, sine, cosine, tangent, and vector operations in fixed-point format.

methods.name: FT_Sin
methods.description: Returns the sine of a given angle in fixed point format.

methods.name: FT_Cos
methods.description: Returns the cosine of a given angle in fixed point format.

methods.name: FT_Tan
methods.description: Returns the tangent of a given angle in fixed point format.

methods.name: FT_Atan2
methods.description: Returns the arc-tangent (angle) from vector coordinates (x,y).

methods.name: FT_Angle_Diff
methods.description: Returns the difference between two angles constrained to (-PI, PI].

methods.name: FT_Vector_Unit
methods.description: Calculates the unit vector corresponding to a given angle.

methods.name: FT_Vector_Rotate
methods.description: Rotates a vector by a given angle.

methods.name: FT_Vector_Length
methods.description: Returns the length of a vector.

methods.name: FT_Vector_Polarize
methods.description: Computes both the length and angle of a vector.

methods.name: FT_Vector_From_Polar
methods.description: Computes vector coordinates from length and angle.
